messages:
devon: heads-up — hosted-prod p95/p99 spike started ~1717004321. p95 ~380ms, p99 ~1.15s. queue_depth for pool-A climbed >120. ops-bot: alert created #incident-837
alyssa: noticed a kernel-affinity flip at the same time, scheduler picked different kernel set for a subset of requests
maria: kernel swap log snippet: `selector: attn_fft_v1 -> attn_generic_fallback` for ~4% of requests (seq len >512)
chen: profiling dump (short):
```
worker.pool-A [1717004322]: selected kernel attn_fft_v1 for seq<=512
worker.pool-A [1717004322]: fallback attn_generic for seq>512
kvcache: hit rate 94% -> 61% after flip
batch_latency: +9ms median, tail widening
cpu: kernel time jump +18%
```
devon: hypothesis: affinity flip caused local KV-cache churn (evictions) -> prefetcher flooded backend -> thundering-herd style request amplification -> queue buildup
maria: tenant X had a burst of long-context requests; their requests were routed to mix of kernels and evicted shared KV entries
sam: can reproduce locally by toggling kernel selection and running mixed seq workload w/ prefetch enabled; prefetch spawns become synchronized and hammer the store
chen: quick mitigation options: 1) disable aggressive prefetch on pool-A 2) reduce prefetch parallelism 3) pin kernel selection policy to avoid flips mid-rollout 4) increase rate-limiter headroom for short window
devon: I'm going to disable aggressive prefetch on pool-A now: `POST /admin/pools/A/prefetch?action=disable` -> applied (ops-bot ack)
ops-bot: prefetch disabled on pool-A by devon at 1717004330
maria: monitoring: queue_depth 120 -> 48 within 25s, p99 down to ~330ms (very noisy but improving) :thumbsup:
sam: I'll stage a scheduler patch to add jitter to prefetch spawn times and a quick check to avoid kernel flips if kvcache hit-rate delta > 20% during decision window
chen: logging task: capture full flamegraph + kvcache snapshot for the 60s window around 1717004321 and attach to INF-421
devon: creating INF-421 with notes + profiling artifacts. plan: canary scheduler patch (5% traffic) -> monitor kvcache hit-rate and tail latency -> ramp if stable
maria: also add short circuit: if pool kvcache hit drops >25% in 10s, throttle prefetcher and fall back to serialized priming
sam: will open PR with tests that simulate mixed seq patterns and assert no >15% kv hit drop after kernel switch
chen: follow-ups: schedule postmortem, add regression test to nightly perf suite, consider metrics: kvcache_evictions/s and prefetch_spawn/s
devon: thanks all, keeping channel updated. current status: mitigation applied, monitoring in progress.
